data.narrative:
Fervo Energy is a public-stage Climate & Energy company that has raised $1.5B+ to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer set of four same-sector, same-stage companies: QuantumScape ($3.6B), Enovix ($1.0B), Solid Power ($504M), and LanzaTech ($73M), reflecting the wide dispersion typical of frontier energy technology markets.

The peer-median method is the applicable triangulation approach given available data. The median valuation across these four peers is $752M, with a range spanning $73M (LanzaTech floor) to $3.6B (QuantumScape ceiling). This method alone anchors the analysis, as it directly reflects market pricing of comparable public-stage companies operating in the same sector with comparable risk and development profiles.

The triangulated valuation range is $639M to $865M, with a median point of $752M. This narrow band reflects the single-method constraint rather than convergence across multiple approaches. Key uncertainties include the representativeness of the peer sample—given the extreme 50x spread from lowest to highest comparable—and the applicability of public-market multiples to Fervo's specific geothermal technology and commercialization timeline. Additional revenue or profitability-based methods would be required to strengthen conviction in this range.
